fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Kowalski and I live at 848 Heather Road, Riverton, WY 82545. You can reach me on (555) 857-6303 or dmitri.kowalski@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 27 May 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00154. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Kowalski on (555) 857-6303 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 27 May 2025.
Site visit to 848 Heather Road. Neighbour Naomi Santos was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
